item.title: Her Bicycle Was Found But Sierah Was Gone
item.description: Twenty-year-old Sierah Joughin vanished while riding her bicycle home in rural Ohio in 2016. Evidence found near the scene and on James Worley’s property led investigators to him. Worley was convicted of kidnapping and aggravated murder and sentenced to death.

item.title: He Thought His Missing Girlfriend Was Stalking Him
item.description: After Cari Farver vanished in 2012, Dave Kroupa kept receiving threatening messages from her accounts for years. Investigators eventually uncovered the truth: Liz Golyar had killed Cari, impersonated her online and built an elaborate campaign to make it appear she was still alive.

item.title: His Wife’s Story Kept Changing After Greg Was Killed
item.description: Greg Williams was shot dead in his Texas home in 2011. His wife, Michele, first blamed an intruder, then claimed Greg had taken his own life. Investigators rejected both stories, and Michele was ultimately convicted of murder and sentenced to 60 years in prison.

item.title: She Crashed Her Car And Vanished Before Police Arrived
item.description: Maura Murray disappeared in New Hampshire in 2004 after her car went off a snowy road. A passerby spoke with her, but when police arrived minutes later, she was gone. More than 20 years later, no confirmed trace of her has been found and the case remains open.

item.title: Was Frank Abagnale’s Greatest Con His Own Story?
item.description: Frank Abagnale became famous for claims that he posed as a pilot, doctor and lawyer while passing fraudulent checks. But later investigations and public records challenged major parts of his Catch Me If You Can story, suggesting many of his most famous exploits may never have happened.

item.title: His Crashed Car Was Found But Bryce Was Gone
item.description: Bryce Laspisa vanished in 2013 while driving home from college in California. His SUV was found crashed near Castaic Lake with his phone, wallet and laptop still inside, but there was no sign of Bryce. Despite extensive searches, he remains missing.
